name: Josiah
title: The Last Good King
summary: Josiah became king at the age of eight and was the last truly godly king of Judah. When the Book of the Law was found in the temple during restoration work, he led a comprehensive reform. He removed idolatry and renewed the covenant with God. He died tragically in battle against Pharaoh Neco at Megiddo.

keyEvents.title: Sought God as a Youth
keyEvents.description: Already at sixteen, Josiah began to seek God, and at twenty he started his reforms.

keyEvents.title: The Book of the Law Found
keyEvents.description: During temple renovations, the priest Hilkia found the Book of the Law, which was read aloud to the king.

keyEvents.title: Renewal of the Covenant
keyEvents.description: Josiah gathered the people and renewed the covenant with God before all Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: The Great Passover
keyEvents.description: Josiah celebrated a Passover unlike any seen since the days of the judges.

keyEvents.title: Josiah dies in battle
keyEvents.description: Josiah fell in battle against Pharaoh Neco at Megiddo, and all Judah mourned.
